items.text: What a great week to finally be live on Steam, and already we've had a positive response to what our small team here in Wales has grown We've definitely felt inspired by the response and feedback we've received and we are making notes and cooking updates to enhance what we've built. So with that in mind here are the notes for our latest patch, and the first since we released on Steam 4 days ago.

The headlines are we have listened and our cutting edge PotBots have been rewired to just chill out a bit! Easy bots now should feel... Easy? and challenges against them in single player less intense. And we've had requests to allow empty player slots in creating versus matches, this is now possible! We'd note that arenas have been balanced for 4 players going head to head, so this is not a 'core' gameplay type but we are very happy to give options for how folks would like to play/garden!

There are more feature adjustments we'd like to make and responses to feedback coming so stick with us and we'll update as soon as we are able. Thank you again to everyone who has sown, grown and subsequently thrown in Planted!

Added Dynamic bot difficulty scaling based on player progression towards gold medals.
Added Support for empty player slots when creating a versus game, allowing games with fewer than four players.
Added Sabotage scoring for successfully shrinking opponent produce.
Added Bot catch-up balancing to help in competitive matches.
Updated
Updated Increased the Eagle's cooldown at the summit of the Mountain Arena.
Updated Volcano Stage 01 bot scaling to reduce early scoring burst.
Updated Sell zone timers to improve responsiveness and consistency for clients during online play.
Updated Bot balancing during multiplayer, so bots better match the leading player's performance.
Fixed
Fixed Intermittent crash when cloud bottle breaks.
Fixed An issue where Mountaineers could fail to become valid sell targets.
Fixed A lock-up that could occur when the camera is in follow mode.
Fixed Team results not showing the correct slot icon for missing/unconnected players.
For updates on Planted! and a place to share feedback, turnip to the Discord and become part of the Planted! Lottie!
Well, this isn't quite the 'launch' day we had in mind...

Since we announced back in April, we've been all over the world with Planted!. From London to Cologne to Tokyo, and the response has been awesome! People smiling, laughing, and telling us how much they enjoy the game - whether you've played the demo at home or joined us at an event, THANK YOU for your passion, enthusiasm, and support! We're so grateful.

The plan has always been to release before the end of the year, and have our horticultural combat party game ready for the festive season as it is at its best when played together with friends and family. But like all best laid plans, there has been a bit of an unexpected curveball.

Unfortunately, the Steam version of Planted will not release simultaneously alongside the PlayStation and Xbox digital versions. As of writing, our Steam build is currently awaiting approval and we don’t have a timeframe for the release to share with you.

The moment we can launch our build on Steam, we will shout about it from the rooftops across all our channels. But for now, it's a waiting game. We could release later today, or it could be next week. We honestly just don't know right now and are deeply sorry for that.
Thank you so much for your support and patience - we cannot wait to open up our gardens to everyone whether they’re on Steam, PlayStation or Xbox!
Let the Extreme Gardening begin!
Cloth Cat and Curveball Games
